lesion.joint: one per pair: tasks.disabled_joints (row field disabled_joint, counted from 0)
lesion.until: the end of each trial; undone before the next placement

network.how: threshold of every neuron raised to 1e12 mV at onset (no input makes it fire); each neuron's threshold and potential at onset written back when the trial ends
network.takes_effect: at once for the share halves; the written goal ring's 3-tick window still holds older spikes, so the target goes missing (motor) or settles on the joint (allocation) within 0.15 s
